name: folio
description: Connect Claude Code to a Folio wiki over MCP: search, read and update pages, tables and whiteboards, with a skill that explains how.

folio_mcp_url.title: Folio MCP address
folio_mcp_url.description: The full address of your Folio's MCP endpoint, for example https://your-folio.example.com/mcp

folio_token.title: Folio personal access token
folio_token.description: Create it in Folio: user menu, API tokens. Scope read for questions, write to let the agent edit. Stored in your system's secure storage.
